instruction: A candid documentary full shot of an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands upright facing right. On the right, the man in the black shirt and blue shorts (R1) balances on his left leg, delivering a mid-level kick with his right leg to the woman's thigh while leaning back. Bright overhead fluorescent lighting illuminates the entire scene, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R1 delivers a mid-level kick to R2's thigh
R2 receives the kick while standing upright
R1 balances on his left leg while kicking with his right leg
R1 leans back during the kick
the action occurs on a red carpeted floor in an indoor motion capture studio
